# Bug report

Thank you for writing this up. The more precise the report is, the faster it can be
fixed, and a report that can be reproduced is worth ten reports that cannot.

## Version

Which version, tag or commit you are working from.

## Environment

The operating system, the runtime version, and everything else that changes the
result: the tool that starts the stack, the mode it runs in, and whether it fails on a
fresh machine or only after an earlier change.

## Steps to reproduce

1. The first thing to do.
2. The next thing to do.
3. The result you saw.

## Expected result

What you expected to happen, in a sentence or two.

## Actual result

What happened instead, in a sentence or two. The exact wording of an error message is
worth copying as it is.

## Anything else

The part of the tree you were in, the command you ran, and anything that looks
related. A short excerpt of a log is welcome.

## What must not be pasted here

Please do not paste a credential, a token, a key, an address, a hostname, or any other
detail that identifies a real system. This repository is public and so is every issue
in it. Replace such details with the placeholder forms the documentation uses, and say
in the report that you have done so.

If the problem is a security problem, do not open a public issue at all. Report it
privately, the way [the security policy](../../SECURITY.md) describes.
